## Who is SoCal BOOM for?

The meeting is for people interested in marine biogeochemistry, including
students, postdoctoral researchers, faculty, researchers, and undergraduates.
The program spans observational, experimental, proxy-based, theoretical, and
modeling approaches.

## Who may submit an abstract?

At the 2027 meeting, oral and poster presentations were open to graduate
students and postdoctoral researchers. Eligibility for the next meeting will
be confirmed on the [Abstracts](scientific-program/abstracts.qmd) page.

## Do I need to present in order to attend?

No. Previous meetings welcomed attendees who were not presenting, including
undergraduates, faculty, and other researchers.
